<thought>We need the number of aromatic carbon atoms in the unknown sample. The best way is to obtain its 13C NMR spectrum, which will show signals for aromatic carbons (typically in the 110‑160 ppm range). By counting those signals we can determine the number of aromatic carbons. We'll request the carbon NMR spectrum for the sample at hand.</thought>
